[EN] Do Not Meddle in the Affairs of Dracoloths
[ES] No te metas en los asuntos de los dracoloths
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Corrupted or not, a dracoloth is nothing to sneeze at. Be careful!
[ES] Corrupto o no, un dracoloth no es algo para tomarse a la ligera. ¡Ten cuidado!
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] I've never met anyone who slew a dracoloth. Remarkable!
[ES] Nunca había conocido a nadie que matara a un dracoloth. ¡Notable!
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Dracoloth Heart
[ES] Corazón de dracoloth
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Kill the dracoloths in the Plaza of the Fallen.
[ES] Mata a los dracoloths en la Plaza of the Fallen.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Bring the hearts to Arast at Valumnir Outpost.
[ES] Llévale los corazones a Arast en el puesto avanzado de Valumnir.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Just doing my duty."
[ES] "Solo cumplo con mi deber."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
